manual.title: Sine plus cosine equal to one over root two
manual.prompt: Solve $\sin x+\cos x=\dfrac1{\sqrt2}$ for $0\le x\le2\pi$.

manual.title: Triple angle cosine to solve a cubic in cos x
manual.prompt: Show that $\cos3x=4\cos^{3}x-3\cos x$, and hence solve $8\cos^{3}x-6\cos x=1$ for $0\le x\le\pi$.
hints: cos 2x cos x − sin 2x sin x.

ladder.nudge: cos 2x cos x − sin 2x sin x.

manual.title: Product of sine seventy five and cos fifteen
manual.prompt: Use a product-to-sum identity to find the exact value of $2\sin75^\circ\cos15^\circ$.

manual.title: Tangent from a compound angle equation
manual.prompt: Given $\sin(x+30^\circ)=2\cos x$, find the exact value of $\tan x$.

manual.title: Exact sine of eighteen degrees
manual.prompt: Let $\theta=18^\circ$. Using $2\theta=90^\circ-3\theta$, show that $4\sin^{2}\theta+2\sin\theta-1=0$ and hence find $\sin18^\circ$ exactly.

manual.title: t formula equation with a solution at pi
manual.prompt: Use $t=\tan\tfrac x2$ to solve $2\sin x-\cos x=1$ for $0\le x\le2\pi$, giving non-exact answers to two decimal places.
hints: t is undefined at x = π.

ladder.worked: t is undefined at x = π.

manual.title: Three cosines spaced by one hundred and twenty degrees
manual.prompt: Use a sum-to-product identity to prove that $\cos A+\cos(A+120^\circ)+\cos(A+240^\circ)=0$.

manual.title: Sine two x from tangent of x plus a quarter pi
manual.prompt: Given $\tan\left(x+\tfrac\pi4\right)=3$, find $\tan x$ and hence $\sin2x$.
hints: sin 2x in terms of tan x.

ladder.method: sin 2x in terms of tan x.

manual.title: All three ratios from t equal to two
manual.prompt: If $\tan\tfrac x2=2$, find the exact values of $\sin x$, $\cos x$ and $\tan x$.

manual.title: Sum of three sines factorised
manual.prompt: Show that $\sin x+\sin2x+\sin3x=\sin2x(1+2\cos x)$ and hence solve $\sin x+\sin2x+\sin3x=0$ for $0\le x\le\pi$.

manual.title: Difference of tangents about forty five degrees
manual.prompt: Prove that $\tan(45^\circ+x)-\tan(45^\circ-x)=2\tan2x$.

manual.title: Difference of fourth powers as a double angle
manual.prompt: Show that $\cos^{4}x-\sin^{4}x=\cos2x$ and hence solve $\cos^{4}x-\sin^{4}x=\tfrac12$ for $0\le x\le\pi$.

manual.title: A t identity with sine in both numerator and denominator
manual.prompt: Using $t=\tan\tfrac x2$, prove that $\dfrac{1-\cos x+\sin x}{1+\cos x+\sin x}=\tan\dfrac x2$.

manual.title: Sum of sines five x and three x
manual.prompt: Show that $\sin5x+\sin3x=2\sin4x\cos x$ and hence solve $\sin5x+\sin3x=0$ for $0\le x\le\tfrac\pi2$.

manual.title: Compound cosine with angles in quadrants two and three
manual.prompt: $A$ is in the second quadrant with $\sin A=\tfrac45$, and $B$ is in the third quadrant with $\cos B=-\tfrac{12}{13}$. Find $\cos(A-B)$ and $\sin(A+B)$.
hints: cos A cos B + sin A sin B.
sin A cos B + cos A sin B.

ladder.method: cos A cos B + sin A sin B.
ladder.worked: sin A cos B + cos A sin B.

manual.title: Tan two x equal to three tan x
manual.prompt: Solve $\tan2x=3\tan x$ for $0\le x\le\pi$.

manual.title: Three cos plus two sin equal to three via t
manual.prompt: Use $t=\tan\tfrac x2$ to solve $3\cos x+2\sin x=3$ for $0\le x\le2\pi$, to two decimal places where needed.

manual.title: Cosine difference over sine sum equals tan x
manual.prompt: Use sum-to-product identities to show that $\dfrac{\cos x-\cos3x}{\sin x+\sin3x}=\tan x$.
hints: cos A − cos B = −2 sin((A+B)/2) sin((A−B)/2).

ladder.nudge: cos A − cos B = −2 sin((A+B)/2) sin((A−B)/2).

manual.title: Product of cosine of sum and difference
manual.prompt: Show that $\cos(A+B)\cos(A-B)=\cos^{2}A-\sin^{2}B$ and use it to evaluate $\cos75^\circ\cos15^\circ$.

manual.title: Exact tangent of pi on eight
manual.prompt: Show that $\dfrac{1-\cos2x}{\sin2x}=\tan x$ and hence find $\tan\dfrac\pi8$ exactly.

manual.title: Comparing the t method with checking x equal to pi
manual.prompt: Solve $4\sin x-3\cos x=3$ for $0\le x\le2\pi$ using $t=\tan\tfrac x2$. Explain why one solution is not produced by the equation in $t$.
hints: What is t at x = π?

ladder.worked: What is t at x = π?

manual.title: Two sin plus cos equal to one and a half
manual.prompt: Write $2\sin x+\cos x$ as $R\sin(x+\alpha)$ with $\alpha$ to four decimal places, and solve $2\sin x+\cos x=1.5$ for $0\le x\le2\pi$, to two decimal places.

manual.title: Cos five x plus cos x as a product
manual.prompt: Show that $\cos5x+\cos x=2\cos3x\cos2x$ and hence solve $\cos5x+\cos x=0$ for $0\le x\le\tfrac\pi2$.

diagram.alt: Graph drawn on x and y axes; 1 plotted line, curve or set of points is drawn. Read the question for what it asks.

manual.title: Tangents of two angles summing to a quarter turn
manual.prompt: If $A+B=\dfrac\pi4$, prove that $(1+\tan A)(1+\tan B)=2$.

manual.title: Sine four x in powers of sine and cosine
manual.prompt: Show that $\sin4x=4\sin x\cos x-8\sin^{3}x\cos x$.

manual.title: Difference of sines seven x and three x
manual.prompt: Express $\sin7x-\sin3x$ as a product of trigonometric functions.

manual.title: Reciprocal of five plus three cos x in t
manual.prompt: Using $t=\tan\tfrac x2$, show that $\dfrac1{5+3\cos x}=\dfrac{1+t^{2}}{8+2t^{2}}$.

manual.title: Three sines of ten fifty and seventy degrees
manual.prompt: Prove that $\sin50^\circ-\sin70^\circ+\sin10^\circ=0$.

manual.title: Sine of a difference over a product of sines
manual.prompt: Show that $\dfrac{\sin(x-y)}{\sin x\sin y}=\cot y-\cot x$ whenever $\sin x\sin y\ne0$.

steps.d: $\dfrac{\sin x\cos y-\cos x\sin y}{\sin x\sin y}$

manual.title: Double angle equation with an irrational cosine
manual.prompt: Solve $3\cos2x+2=7\cos x$ for $0\le x\le2\pi$, to two decimal places.

manual.title: Finding the solution a student missed
manual.prompt: A student solves $\sin x-\cos x=1$ for $0\le x\le2\pi$ using $t=\tan\tfrac x2$ and finds only $x=\tfrac\pi2$. Show their working, find the missing solution and explain why it was missed.

manual.title: Sine plus cosine at least one
manual.prompt: Solve $\sin x+\cos x\ge1$ for $0\le x\le2\pi$.

diagram.alt: Graph drawn on x and y axes; 2 plotted lines, curves or sets of points are drawn; some of the plotted lines are dashed. Labels include: 2 pi. Read the question for what it asks.

manual.title: Product of cosines of twenty forty and eighty degrees
manual.prompt: Use product-to-sum identities to prove that $\cos20^\circ\cos40^\circ\cos80^\circ=\tfrac18$.
hints: 2cos A cos B = cos(A + B) + cos(A − B).

ladder.nudge: 2cos A cos B = cos(A + B) + cos(A − B).
